CURRENT QUESTION:
2024 total loan amount compared to 2023 total, percentage growth
attempts.response:
```sql
WITH yearly_loans AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST("Disbursement Date" AS DATE)) = 2023 THEN "Loan Amount (Rs)" END) AS total_2023,
    SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST("Disbursement Date" AS DATE)) = 2024 THEN "Loan Amount (Rs)" END) AS total_2024
  FROM "shg_loan_register"
)
SELECT
  total_2023,
  total_2024,
  (total_2024 - total_2023) * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_2023, 0) AS percentage_growth
FROM yearly_loans;
```
